metadata.authority: NovaPharm Section 70 SOP evidence provenance contract
metadata.purpose: Define the minimum machine-verifiable evidence required before an SOP may be promoted from repository-executable status to rehearsed managed staging or production accepted.

rehearsalEvidence.rule: REHEARSED_MANAGED_STAGING requires at least one managed-staging PASS record for the SOP with a 40-character source SHA, normalized UTC timestamp, named operator, target, evidence references, and no failed rollback or recovery disposition.

productionAcceptanceEvidence.rule: PRODUCTION_ACCEPTED requires at least one production PASS record bound to R6 PRODUCTION ACCEPTED with a 40-character source SHA, normalized UTC timestamp, named acceptor, target, evidence references, and no failed rollback or recovery disposition.

promotionRules.REHEARSED_MANAGED_STAGING: Structured rehearsal evidence is mandatory and must contain a qualifying PASS record.
promotionRules.PRODUCTION_ACCEPTED: Structured rehearsal evidence and structured production acceptance evidence are mandatory; production evidence must contain a qualifying R6 PASS record.
promotionRules.allOtherStatuses: Rehearsal and production acceptance arrays must remain empty so repository presence cannot be mistaken for environment acceptance.
